description: ybrid planning permission is sought for a comprehensive,phased and residential led development at Stratford Cross forthe following:(a) With all matters reserved (the Outline Element) for futuredetermination for purpose built student accommodation("PBSA") (Sui Generis) AND/OR large scale purpose builtshared living ("LSPBSL") (sui generis); non-residentialfloorspace comprising Class E, F1 (b), (d) and (f), F2 and SuiGeneris (public house, wine bar or drinking establishment,drinking establishment with expanded food provision, hotfood takeaway, live music performance venue or cinema);areas to provide circulation, servicing, car parking and cycleparking; landscaping including laying out of open space; andother supporting infrastructure works and facilities.(b) Detailed permission (the Detailed Element) comprising:(i) residential uses (Class C3);(ii) Non-residential floorspace comprising Class E, F1 (b), (d)and (f), F2 and Sui Generis;(iii) The erection of buildings of varying heights;
